open_questions: Why do equally reviewed ClinVar submissions disagree about rs1801133 in MTHFR, and which mechanism, if any, makes this allele disease-relevant?

hypotheses.title: Context‑dependent metabolic effect
hypotheses.mechanism: The Ala222Val substitution modestly reduces MTHFR enzymatic activity, leading to altered folate and homocysteine metabolism that only translates into disease risk under specific environmental or nutritional conditions (e.g., low folate intake), which explains the mixed clinical interpretations.

gaps: Direct measurements of MTHFR enzyme activity for each genotype under varying folate concentrations.
Large epidemiologic cohorts with both genotype and detailed dietary folate data linked to disease outcomes.
Longitudinal homocysteine and methylation biomarker data stratified by rs1801133 genotype.
hypotheses.discriminating_observation: Carriers of the A allele show a significant increase in homocysteine and disease incidence only in low‑folate subpopulations, while no effect is seen in high‑folate groups.
hypotheses.experiment: Create isogenic cell lines (CRISPR‑edited) differing only at rs1801133, measure MTHFR activity and homocysteine production under a gradient of folate concentrations; complement with a population‑based analysis stratifying disease risk by folate intake.

hypotheses.title: Tagging a nearby causal regulatory variant
hypotheses.mechanism: rs1801133 is in strong linkage disequilibrium with another functional variant that directly influences gene expression or splicing; the observed disease associations are driven by that variant, leading some submitters to label rs1801133 pathogenic based on association data, while others consider it benign because it is not the functional culprit.

gaps: Fine‑mapping of the MTHFR locus to identify all variants in LD with rs1801133 across ancestries.

hypotheses.discriminating_observation: The disease/trait association signal disappears after statistically conditioning on a nearby regulatory variant, while rs1801133 alone shows no independent effect.
hypotheses.experiment: Perform high‑resolution haplotype phasing in diverse cohorts, conduct conditional GWAS analyses, and test candidate regulatory variants in luciferase reporter assays to assess impact on MTHFR expression.

hypotheses.title: Pharmacogenomic relevance rather than disease causality
hypotheses.mechanism: The Ala222Val allele primarily influences drug metabolism (e.g., methotrexate toxicity) without substantially affecting disease risk; submitters focusing on pharmacogenomic evidence label it pathogenic, whereas those evaluating general disease risk consider it benign, creating the observed discordance.
